info.title: PostDream API
info.description: SMTP sandbox API. Authenticate with the UI session cookie or with an inbox API token (`Authorization: Bearer <api_token>`), which is scoped to that inbox.

Chaos.description: SMTP fault injection per stage. Omit a stage to disable it.

allowed_recipients.description: Regex every RCPT TO must match ('' = all)

relay_recipients.description: Regex release recipients must match ('' = releasing disabled)

inbox.description: Inbox id or slug. Optional with an API token (its inbox) - defaults to the default inbox.

raw.description: A complete RFC 5322 message; overrides the other fields

get.summary: Public server configuration and enabled features
Message statistics for the caller's inboxes

delete.summary: Delete an inbox and its messages (admin)

post.summary: Regenerate SMTP password and API token (admin)

put.description: Allowed for admins and for the inbox's own API token, so a test can enable faults, run, and disable them. Send {} to disable.

post.description: Deliveries are signed: X-PostDream-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<body>")>. Failed deliveries are retried with backoff (10s, 30s, 2m, 10m, 30m).

parameters.name: inbox
parameters.description: Rules applying to this inbox (incl. global)

get.summary: Tags in use with message counts

post.description: Goes through the same pipeline as SMTP (tags, rules, webhooks, spam analysis). Nothing is relayed.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search syntax: words, "phrases", from: to: cc: bcc: reply-to: addressed: subject: message-id: tag: is:read|unread|tagged|spam has:attachment|inline|html larger:2M smaller:500K before:/after: (yyyy/mm/dd or 2h, 3d) inbox: smtp-user: ip: header:Name[=value] spam:>5. Prefix with - or ! to negate.
